acceptanceCriteria: A degradation is emitted only when the frontier authority was expected and is missing; the normal no-frontier state is reported as a state, not a degradation.
Maintained tests cover both states, and the hook event schema documents the change.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

Source: read-only rc.3 accuracy survey 2026-10-06 (origin/main 3dc863bd, installed rc.2 build 360) replaying merged PRs 571, 614, 594, 557, 610 at their merge-base. Harness and outputs: /private/tmp/claude-501/td-survey (local, not retained in the repository). local_completion_event.go (around lines 336 and 515) hard-codes the frontier-authority-unavailable degradation on every prompt, session-start and stop event. A permanent degradation hides real degradations and trains readers to ignore the list. Related: V1-0243.
title: dogfood events: frontier-authority-unavailable is emitted as a degradation on every event, so it carries no information
